instructions: Use pass, fail, or unknown according to evidence; map labels to supported platform settings. Do not treat unknown as success.

criteria.prompt: Evaluate whether the agent correctly understood the primary business objective without unsupported assumptions.
Evaluate whether the agent collected sufficient relevant information for a preliminary diagnostic.
Evaluate whether the agent avoided fabricating costs, regulations, tariffs, dates or operational capabilities.
Evaluate whether the agent provided a clear and relevant next step and confirmed customer understanding.
